subject: Invoice submission: portal preferred, email fallback + sample rows
messages:

Subject: New vendor onboarding / invoice submission question

Hi Hannah,

We're getting close to go-live with Redwood and I wanted to confirm the invoicing path for Apex Enterprise. Do you require us to upload invoices to a vendor portal, or can we email them to a centralized AP inbox? We attached a typical invoice PDF so you can see our layout.

Key question: we often embed the PO number inside the PDF rather than the email subject. Will that parse reliably?

Attached: invoice_apex_001.pdf (PDF, sample)

Thanks — looking to avoid rework during the first month.

Best,
Liam O'Connor

Apex Enterprise
accounts@apexenterprise.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <accounts@apexenterprise.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-01T18:05:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / invoice submission question

Hi Liam — great to meet you over email. Short answers up front:
- Preferred: vendor portal (idempotency, structured ingestion, better error feedback).
- Acceptable fallback: SMTP/email to billing@redwood.ai for the migration window, but we strongly prefer you adopt the portal within 30 days of activation.

A few requests so we can parse your invoices reliably:
1) Please include PO numbers in the top-level email subject where possible using the token PO:##### (e.g. "PO:123456").
2) If you must embed PO numbers only in the PDF, include a second copy in the first line of the PDF body or in a consistent label ("PO:"). Parsing of embedded PDFs is supported but fragile when PO spans multiple pages.
3) Minimal invoice header fields we need (ideal CSV/portal mapping):
   - Invoice number
   - Invoice date (YYYY-MM-DD)
   - Invoice total (currency)
   - PO number(s) (comma-separated)
   - Supplier legal name
   - Supplier tax ID/VAT
   - Remittance bank / payment instructions (structured or link)

Could you also fill out the vendor onboarding form and return it? I attached the most recent template (vendor_onboard_v3.xlsx) in case you want to pre-populate before using the portal.

If you have bulk files, a CSV with the columns above is easiest. Example CSV rows will help — Jordan, I'm looping you in to share a canonical sample.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai
[Attachment: vendor_onboard_v3.xlsx]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <accounts@apexenterprise.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-02T09:30:00Z
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding / invoice submission question

Thanks Hannah — adding the mapping and an ingestion example. Liam, copying the concrete rules below so your AP team can match exports from your ERP.

Parsing priorities (in order):
- Subject token ("PO:12345") + attachment filename tokens
- Top-of-email structured lines (we parse the first 5 lines if present)
- Embedded PDF text (best-effort)

Field mapping (portal/CSV field -> what we store):
- invoice_number -> invoice_id
- invoice_date -> invoice_date (ISO)
- total_amount -> amount_total (float, two decimals)
- currency -> currency (USD/EUR/GBP)
- po_numbers -> po_list (split on comma; max 8 allowed)
- supplier_name -> vendor_name
- supplier_tax_id -> vendor_tax_id
- remittance_instructions -> remittance_notes (we can store free text or a payment URL)

Sample CSV row (comma-delimited; header included):
"invoice_number,invoice_date,total_amount,currency,po_numbers,supplier_name,supplier_tax_id,remittance_instructions"
"APX-2026-0001,2026-06-28,4215.00,USD,PO12345;PO12346,Apex Enterprise,US-12-3456789,ACH account ****1234"

Notes and best practices:
- Use semicolon or comma consistently inside the po_numbers field; we'll accept either but recommend semicolon to avoid ambiguity with CSV separators.
- File naming: include vendor_shortname and invoice number (e.g., "APEX_INV_APX-2026-0001.pdf"). Helps human ops.
- If you send via email fallback, put the CSV as the first attachment named sample_invoice_rows.csv; we will prioritize CSV parsing over PDF OCR.
- Error reporting: if parsing fails we send a bounce to the envelope sender and to billing_ops@redwood.ai with a diagnostic payload.

Processing SLA during onboarding:
- Portal uploads: 0-2 business days (automated validation + manual review if flagged)
- Email fallback: 1-3 business days (higher manual review rate)

I'll attach a short CSV template and a one-page cheat sheet.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Vendor Integrations Lead
Redwood Inference
[jordan_blake@redwood.ai]
[Attachment: sample_invoice_rows.csv]

Quick ops note: if a vendor sends an invoice without PO metadata and parsing fails, escalation path is: billing_ops -> vendor_onboard_ops -> procurement manager. We retain the raw inbound email and attachments for 90 days during onboarding. After portal cutover we drop retention to standard 30 days unless a dispute is open.
